description: Source file defining the SugarTinyMCE class, which is a PHP wrapper for integrating the TinyMCE WYSIWYG HTML editor in the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM environment. It includes configuration setup, initialization scripts, and methods for cleaning HTML and loading custom configs.

classes.name: SugarTinyMCE
classes.description: PHP wrapper class for TinyMCE WYSIWYG HTML editor, providing configuration management, JavaScript generation, and HTML sanitation methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the SugarTinyMCE object, initializing button, config, and language customizations.

methods.name: resolveConfigType
methods.description: Resolves legacy config type aliases to the current config type names.

methods.name: validateConfigType
methods.description: Validates that the config type exists; defaults to 'standard' if invalid.

methods.name: buildConfig
methods.description: Builds the TinyMCE configuration array based on the specified type.

methods.name: getConfigArray
methods.description: Returns the TinyMCE configuration array for a specified type.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code to initialize TinyMCE instances for given target elements.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns the JavaScript code snippet defining the TinyMCE configuration.

methods.name: cleanEncodedMCEHtml
methods.description: Cleans TinyMCE-specific HTML code, removing editor-specific attributes.

methods.name: overloadButtonConfigs
methods.description: Reloads button configurations from an external file if available.

methods.name: overloadDefaultConfigs
methods.description: Reloads default TinyMCE configs from an external file if available.

methods.name: overloadLanguageConfigs
methods.description: Sets language-specific configuration based on current language.
